**STEP 2 - Vessel:** White paper plate, about 23 cm diameter. Area = 3.14 × (11.5)² ≈ 415 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** Chicken pieces in sauce, with red and green bell pepper pieces.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Chicken and pepper cover about 60% of the plate (≈249 cm²). The rest is bare plate.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Typical pile height ≈ 1.2 cm, so 249 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 299 ml gross.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** 299 ml × 0.9 g/ml (dense meat and sauce) ≈ 269 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Sauced stir-fried chicken with peppers is roughly 160 kcal/100 g as plated. 269 g × 1.6 ≈ 430 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A visible pile of about 250 to 300 g of chicken and pepper, covering most of a paper plate, is plausible. About 430 kcal fits a typical portion of this dish.

Estimated total: about 269 g and about 430 kcal (fruit bowl and drinks excluded).
